svg.title: Experience and education
svg.desc: Experience. Campus Ambassador, Northeastern University London, London, UK, Aug 2026 to now. Senior Analyst, IT Support, Capgemini, Noida, India, Jun 2023 to Dec 2025. Built a Python tool that used an LLM to turn prose access requests into proposed Active Directory changes for my approval. It saved me 2 to 5 hours a week. Associate, Technical Support, Tech Mahindra, Noida, India, Aug 2022 to Jun 2023. Associate, Customer Support, Tech Mahindra, India, Aug 2021 to May 2022. Education. MSc Artificial Intelligence & Computer Science, Northeastern University London · dissertation on guardrails for LLM agents, Jan 2026 to Jan 2027, In progress. Advanced Certificate Programme in Data Science, IIIT Bangalore with upGrad · NLP specialisation, Jan 2025 to Oct 2025, CGPA 3.85 / 4.0. Bachelor of Computer Applications, Chandigarh University, Sep 2021 to Sep 2024, Completed alongside full-time work. Diploma, Computer Science & Engineering, Kalinga University, Raipur, 2018 to 2021, 81% · first division.
